sources.title: Maximilian228/Geode-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The experts are read from the phone's storage as they are needed, so the whole model does not have to fit in RAM. The packs are Geode's own format (geode.json describes the files; the experts in a GPU-friendly tiled layout).
